Which diseases are associated with BRCA1?
✓ Answered 11.4s · 3 tools · 3 layers · 3 sources Show work ▾

BRCA1 is associated with hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome, the best-characterised of its disease links 1 Gene 672.

The current MedGen record describes an autosomal dominant inheritance pattern 2 MedGen C0677776.

Biallelic variants have also been reported in Fanconi anemia complementation group S, drawn from the literature rather than a curated record 3 PMID 21990134.
